tools.name: dsar_deadline
tools.description: Calculate the statutory deadline for answering a data subject access request in the UK, the EU/EEA or Switzerland, with the rule that applies and the extension position. General information, not legal advice.

tools.name: dsar_quote
tools.description: Fixed price from Double AIgents for preparing a DSAR response, by pack size in pages after de-duplication. Also gives the retainer price (15% off). Excludes VAT.

tools.name: dsar_service_info
tools.description: What the Double AIgents DSAR service covers: scoping, collection guidance, de-duplication, redaction, exemption recommendations, two independent reviews, secure delivery, data handling, jurisdictions and partner arrangements.

tools.name: dsar_request_scoping
tools.description: Explains how to start free scoping and returns a prefilled email (mailto URL) to james@doubleaigents.com. Sends nothing and stores nothing. Do not pass the requester's personal data or the request letter.

tools.name: breach_clock

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: breach_triage · Private data: hr_retention, dsar_search_checklist · Public sink: dsar_request_scoping, breach_clock.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: breach_triage · Private data: hr_retention, dsar_search_checklist · Public sink: dsar_request_scoping, breach_clock

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
